exchanges: hello, just put the kettle on. what a morning.
Hello. What made it such a morning?
the garden had its fall work bee, about thirty people showed up, more than we've ever had.
That is a great turnout. What did everyone work on?
mulching, mostly. sunita, our coordinator, gave a little speech at the end because she's leaving us.
That must have been emotional. Where is she going?
her husband got a job out east so they're moving to Halifax after christmas. we'll miss her terribly.
It is hard to lose someone who holds a group together.
the funny thing is my cousin, also called sunita, is moving too. she told me last week she's off to Winnipeg for her new job.
Two Sunitas on the move at once, that is quite a coincidence.
everyone is leaving me, ha.
It can feel that way when several changes come at once.
my husband ewan says i should take up something new to keep busy. he's got his records out again, Supertramp at full volume, his favourite band since university.
Music can be a good mood lifter.
he sings along too, badly.
That is part of the charm.
i did start birdwatching this summer, actually. i'm hooked.
That is a lovely hobby. What have you spotted so far?
a pileated woodpecker at the garden last week. i almost cried.
What a find. They are such striking birds.
i bought a proper pair of binoculars after that, they were not cheap.
Good optics make a big difference.
my son Tariq called to tell me his little boy Idris lost his first tooth.
A big milestone. Did the tooth fairy visit?
of course, five dollars! inflation.
The tooth fairy has had to keep up with prices.
i'm also learning Mandarin, believe it or not. tariq's wife is from chengdu and i want to talk with her parents.
That is a thoughtful reason to learn.
the tones are so hard. my teacher says i'm doing well but i think she's being kind.
Tones take time for everyone. Keep at it.
oh, i have to fix something. my cousin sunita isn't going to winnipeg. i got the cities mixed up, it's Regina.
Thanks for clearing that up.
both cold anyway.
Very true, she will need a good coat.
my friend magdalena is going to Seville in the spring for three weeks.
That sounds like a wonderful trip.
she wants me to come but i don't like flying anymore.
Flying can be tiring. Maybe a shorter trip somewhere closer instead?
maybe. i have a hearing test on Friday, ewan says i ignore him but i think he mumbles.
It is good to get checked either way.
we'll see who's right.
The results will settle the argument.
after the test i'm going to treat myself at the Lantern, my favourite little café on main street.
A nice reward after an appointment.
their date squares are the best.
Those sound worth the trip.
it's getting dark so early now.
The shorter days are noticeable this time of year.
i should get the bird feeder filled before it's dark.
The birds will be glad of it.
done. two chickadees already.
They never miss a chance.
where's the garden sunita relocating to again?
my granddaughter ines just sent me a video of her playing the violin, she's only seven.
That is impressive for seven. How did it sound?
a bit squeaky but i loved it.
That is how everyone starts.

earlier_question.right_reply: Sunita from the garden is moving to Halifax.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Sunita from the garden is moving to Winnipeg.

questions.message: what language am i studying again?
my cousin sunita's moving to Winnipeg, right?
i think i'll make soup tonight, it's cold enough.
what's the name of magdalena's kid?
is ewan going on any trips soon?
sorry, which city is our coordinator going to live in?
